hero.badge: Built with board-game clubs, not just for them
hero.subtitle: DiceHub turns board-game nights into a living community — table reservations, a shared game library, meeple matchmaking, and XP-driven challenges, all in one app for players and the clubs that host them.

built_in.realtime_desc: Live table availability, not a guess

features.title: Everything a clubhouse runs on, in one app.
features.subtitle: Members get a reason to come back. Owners get the tools to run the place without a clipboard.
features.library_desc: Catalog every box on your shelf — categories, player counts, difficulty, and instant availability so members always know what's free to play.
features.meeples_desc: Meeple matchmaking connects members by favorite games, skill level, and schedule — so no one's stuck waiting for a fourth player.
features.reservations_desc: Real-time table availability with QR check-in — book a spot for tonight or lock in next week's campaign session.
features.challenges_desc: Members earn XP, level up, and unlock badges for trying new games, hitting milestones, and just showing up.
features.events_desc: Tournaments, campaigns, and game nights with RSVP tracking, bracket-ready sign-ups, and automatic reminders.
features.leaderboards_desc: Club-wide and per-game leaderboards keep the competitive fire alive — win streaks, top scores, season standings.

how_it_works_section.title: From sign-up to season leaderboard.
how_it_works_section.step1_desc: Scan a QR code at the venue or accept an invite, then set up your player profile — favorite games, skill level, and availability.
how_it_works_section.step2_desc: Grab a table, browse the library for something new, or let meeple matchmaking find you a group for tonight.
how_it_works_section.step3_desc: Earn XP, complete challenges, and climb the leaderboard every time you show up and play.

for_clubs.title: Built for the person who runs the clubhouse, too.
for_clubs.subtitle: DiceHub isn't just a member app — it's the operating system for your space.
for_clubs.bullet1_desc: see every table's status at a glance, avoid double-bookings.
for_clubs.bullet2_desc: track condition, missing pieces, and checkout history.
for_clubs.bullet3_desc: build brackets, manage RSVPs, send reminders automatically.
for_clubs.bullet4_desc: attendance trends, popular games, and engagement analytics.
for_clubs.cta: Talk to us about your club

why.title: We're new — here's what that means for you.
why.card1_desc: We're not going to claim thousands of clubs use DiceHub — we don't have that yet. What we have is a working app, built feature by feature for how clubhouses actually run.
why.card2_title: Onboarding takes a day or two,
why.card2_desc: not minutes. Setting up your game library and tables properly is worth doing right — we'll walk you through it.
why.card3_desc: As one of our first clubs, what you tell us directly shapes what gets built next.

final_cta.title: Ready to roll the dice?
final_cta.subtitle: Start free as a player, or get your club set up in a day or two — no spreadsheet required.

landing.partner_with_us_text: Looking to modernize your entertainment space? Whether you run a board game cafe, darts bar, billiards lounge, or a hybrid venue, DiceHub helps you elevate the experience and grow your community.

instruction.info_description:
Learn how to use the app, including how to reserve games, table,
earn rewards, and explore other important features to enhance your club experience.

owner_setup.title: Getting Started as an Owner
owner_setup.summary: What to set up before you open the club to players

games_qr.title: Games & QR Codes
games_qr.description: Every game gets its own QR code the moment you create it — print it and put it on the game.

every_game_gets_a_code.header: Every game gets its own QR code
every_game_gets_a_code.description: As soon as you add a game to the library, DiceHub generates a QR code for it. Open the game, tap the menu, and choose the QR code option to view or print it.

print_and_attach.header: Print it and put it on the game
print_and_attach.description: Print the QR code and stick it on the game box or its shelf spot, so players can scan it in the club to check availability or start a reservation.

pick_good_images.description: Add a clear, well-lit cover image for every game — it's the first thing players see in the library and on the game card.

rewards_and_custom_period.title: Rewards & Custom Periods
rewards_and_custom_period.description: Set up your rewards, then create your custom period so players start earning.

setup_rewards_first.description: Go to the Rewards tab in the Challenges Manager and add the rewards your players can unlock. Do this before switching Custom Period on.

recommended_order.description: Before turning Custom Period on, make sure you have: 1) all your games added, 2) your rewards set up, 3) your period rewards, period challenges, and universal challenges set up on the Custom Period tab. You can always add more later — this first pass just makes sure the first period isn't empty.

turn_on_custom_period.description: Once your games, rewards and challenges are ready, open Settings, set "Is Custom Period On" to On and Save. You'll be taken to the Custom Period tab to finish the setup.

club_settings.title: Club Settings That Matter
club_settings.description: These settings drive reward periods and background jobs — get them right before you open.

reset_day.description: How often the reward period restarts (weekly or monthly). When it resets, players' point progress starts over — they keep any rewards they've already earned, only the running point count resets.

reservation_hours.description: Sets the hours players are allowed to reserve games and tables. Change it anytime to match your club's opening hours.

challenge_rewards_count.description: How many rewards are available in a single period — 5, 10, or whatever fits your club. Change it whenever you like.

time_zone.description: Make sure this is set correctly. Every background job — closing tables, resetting reward periods, expiring rewards — runs on this time zone.

days_off.description: Also feeds the background jobs, so keep it up to date with your club's actual closing days.

employees.title: Add Your Employees
employees.description: Give your staff their own accounts with extra permissions.

add_from_profile.description: From the Profile tab, tap the Employees tile. Your staff list lives here — use the + button to add someone. They get special roles beyond a normal user, so they can approve reservations, manage games, and more.

fill_the_form.description: Enter their first name, last name, email and phone number, then tap Create. They'll get an email to set their password and can sign in with their staff role.

reservation.title: Reservations
reservation.summary: Reserve a game, table, or a combination of both

game.title: Game
game.description: Learn how to reserve a game step by step.

how_to_reserve_game.description:
Tap the game library icon in the bottom-left corner. Use the list or search bar to find a game you want to play.
After selecting a game, click on Availability
Select your arrival time and number of players — we’ll reserve a table for you.
You’ll be notified when your reservation is approved or declined.
If approved, please arrive 2–10 minutes before the timer ends.

reservation_approved.description:
Once your reservation is approved, you'll see a QR code and an info panel.
You can access this panel anytime from the red Games Tab in the top-right corner (it will glow when updated).
This panel shows important details and updates about your reservation.

message_from_staff.description: Your info panel may include notes from staff about your reservation — make sure to read them.

checking_in_with_qr_code.header: Checking In with Your QR Code
checking_in_with_qr_code.description: Show your QR code to the club staff when you arrive. They’ll scan it to confirm your reservation.

reservation_is_declined.description: If your reservation is not approved, you’ll see a message explaining why it was declined.

no_one_responds_to_reservation.header: If No One Responds to Your Reservation
no_one_responds_to_reservation.description: If your reservation isn’t acknowledged in time, you’ll get a additional message.

table.title: Table
table.description: Learn how to reserve a table.

how_to_reserve_table.description:
Tap the circular icon with crossed swords at the bottom center of the screen.
Then, tap the top icon to open the Club Space Management page.
There, you can book a table, choosing your arrival time, and entering the number of players.
You’ll receive a notification once your reservation is approved or declined.

reservation_approved.description: If your reservation is approved, a QR code and all reservation details will appear in your info panel under Club Space Management page.

message_from_staff.description: Sometimes, staff may leave you a note in the info panel with important information about your reservation.

reservation_declined.description: If your reservation is not approved, try selecting a different time or day.

combination.title: Combination
combination.description: Learn how to combine both a table and a game reservation into one seamless experience.

reserve_table.description: Start by learning how to book a table. Follow the instructions provided in the link below to secure your spot.

game_reservation.header: Step 2: Game Reservation on the Day of Your Visit
game_reservation.description:
On the day of your table reservation, you’ll receive a special message on the game availability page. This message will include your table details.

Exactly **1 hour before** your reserved time, you’ll be able to select and reserve a game.

Once you request a game reservation, it will either be approved or declined depending on availability.

game_reservation_approved.header: If Your Game Reservation is Approved
game_reservation_approved.description: Great! Both your table and your selected game will be ready and waiting for you at the venue.

game_reservation_declined.header: If Your Game Reservation is Declined
game_reservation_declined.description:
Don’t worry your table reservation is still confirmed. You can either:

- Try reserving a different game, or
- Arrive and choose from the games available on-site.

manage_room.title: Tip #1 Manage Your Room
manage_room.description: Easily manage your reservation room — see who’s in, update players, and adjust your settings.

Tap the blue circle at the bottom center of the screen. Then tap the first icon at the top.
This will take you to the Club Space Management page, where you can view and manage your reservation room.
From there, you can update your reservation details or remove players if needed.

events.title: Events
events.summary: Join exciting events and connect with the community through games, challenges, and fun activities.

join_event.title: How to Join an Event
join_event.description: Find and join upcoming community events directly from your app.

1. Tap the **Events** tab at the bottom of your screen.
2. Browse through the list of upcoming events.
3. Select an event to view full details like time, date, and description.
4. Tap **Join Event** to secure your spot!

leave_event.title: How to Leave an Event
leave_event.description: Can’t make it? Easily leave an event you’ve joined.

1. Open the **Events** tab.
2. Go to the **My Events** section.
3. Tap the event you want to leave.
4. Tap **Leave Event** at the bottom of the screen.

notifications.title: Stay Informed with Notifications
notifications.description: Get notified when new events are created.

When your club creates a new event, you'll receive a notification.
Tap the notification to view event details and decide whether to join.

challenges.title: Challenge & Rewards
challenges.summary:
Take part in exciting challenges and earn awesome rewards!
This is your main hub for everything related to challenges, rewards, and friendly competition.

info.title: Challenges
info.description: Learn where, when, and how to complete challenges.

where_to_find.description:
Tap the blue circle at the bottom center of the screen, then tap the middle icon.

This will open your Challenge Page, where you can view both your current challenges and earned rewards.

The first tab (top left) will show whether you're participating in a weekly or monthly challenge period.

how_to_complete.description:
Each challenge tells you which game to play, how many times to play it, and how many points you’ll earn.

These points are added to your total period score.

To successfully complete a challenge, you must start the required game and play it for at least the average game time.

For example: if the average play time for Ghost Stories is 55 minutes, you must play it for at least 55 minutes to get the reward.

when_new_challenges.header: When Do I Get New Challenges?
when_new_challenges.description:
A new challenge is usually generated a few hours after you complete the previous one.
Occasionally, you’ll receive special or time-limited challenges too.

rewards.title: Rewards
rewards.description: Find out how to earn and redeem your rewards.

where_to_see.description:
Tap the blue circle at the bottom center, then the middle icon to open the Challenge Page.
Switch to the second tab (top left) to view all the rewards you’ve earned.

how_to_claim.description:
Once you earn a reward, you’ll have a limited number of days to claim it before it expires.

To redeem it, visit the club and press the “Use” button inside the app.

Show the generated QR code to a staff member to receive your reward.

where_to_view.description:
Go to your Profile page, then find and tap the Challenge Leaderboard section.

You can view your ranking along with the scores of other players.

troubleshooting.title: Troubleshooting
troubleshooting.summary: Having trouble with the app closing, resetting, or losing what you were doing? This section covers the most common cause and how to fix it.

app_resets.title: App resets or loses unsaved data
app_resets.description: If the app suddenly shows the loading/landing screen, or a form or picked image you were working on disappears, it's usually your phone closing the app in the background to save battery - not a bug. These steps fix it on most Android phones.

why.description: Many Android phones (especially Xiaomi/MIUI, Huawei, OnePlus, and Samsung) aggressively close apps that aren't in the foreground to save battery - even if you only switched away for a second, like picking a photo. When the app comes back, it may reload from scratch and lose whatever you hadn't saved yet.

battery.header: Turn off battery restrictions for DiceHubs
battery.description: Go to Settings > Apps > DiceHubs > Battery (wording varies by phone), and choose "No restrictions" or "Unrestricted" instead of "Optimized" or "Restricted".

autostart.description: On some phones (Xiaomi/MIUI, Huawei, OnePlus), go to Settings > Apps > DiceHubs > Autostart (or Permissions > Autostart) and turn it on.

lock_recents.header: Lock the app in Recent Apps
lock_recents.description: Open the Recent Apps switcher, find DiceHubs, and swipe down (or long-press) on its card to "Lock" it. This tells the system not to close it while multitasking.

meeples.title: Meeples
meeples.summary:
Looking for people to play with?
The Meeples section helps you find or create a group of players who want to enjoy the same game as you. Meet new people, connect, and have fun together!

groups.title: Meeple Groups / Find Players
groups.description: Browse and join available groups where players are looking for others to play games with.

view_available.description:
Head to your Meeple page to see a list of open rooms created by other players.
You can browse these and join any group that matches your interest.

create_room.title: Create a Room
create_room.description: Set up your own room and wait for others to join you for a game session.

create.description:
On the Meeple page, tap the green plus (+) button at the top right.
You’ll be taken to the room creation page, where you can set the game, time, and number of players.

join_room.title: Join Room
join_room.description: Join room and meet the new people

join_existing.description:
Browse the list of rooms on the Meeple page.
Tap on a room you’re interested in to view more details and join it.

room_info_chat.description:
Inside each room, you’ll find details about the selected game, scheduled time, and players.
You can also open the chat to talk to other participants, coordinate, or get updates.

how_to_install.title: Install the App
how_to_install.summary: Get step-by-step instructions on installing the app on your device for easy access anytime and improve your notifications.

android_google_chrome.title: Android Google Chrome Installation
android_google_chrome.description: Learn how to install the app on your Android device using Google Chrome browser.

instal.header: Open the App in Google Chrome
instal.description:
Step 1: Launch Google Chrome on your Android device and navigate to the app's website.

Step 2: Click on the three dots on top right corner.

Step 3: From the dropdown menu, select 'Add to Home screen'.

Step 4: Confirm by tapping 'Install'. The app will be installed and a shortcut will appear on your home screen for easy access.

ios_safari.title: Apple Safari Installation
ios_safari.description: Learn how to install the app on your Apple device using IOS Safari browser.

instal.description:
Step 1: Launch the browser on your Apple device and navigate to the app's website.

Step 2: Tap the Share Button.

Step 3: Choose “Add to Home Screen”'.

Step 4: Confirm and add. The app will be installed and a shortcut will appear on your home screen for easy access.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.summary: Information about enabling or unblocking notifications for the app on your device to stay updated with the latest alerts and messages.`

android_unblocked.title: Android: Unblock Your Notifications
android_unblocked.description: Learn how to unblocked notifications for the app on your device.

instal.description:
Step 1: Hold on the application icon on your screen.

Step 2: Tap on 'Site Settings'.

Step 3: Tap On 'Notifications' and Turn ON the 'Show Notifications'. 

Step 4: Restart the application

ios_unblocked.title: Apple-IOS: Unblock Your Notifications
ios_unblocked.description: Learn how to unblocked notifications for the app on your device.

instal.description:
Step 1: Open Settings.

Step 2: Type on the search 'Notifications'.

Step 3: Find the application icon and tab on it 

Step 4: Tap On 'Allow Notifications'. 

Step 5: Restart the application
